beats.say: EA has paused the mobile multiplayer Sims game Project Lotus.
You might think it’s about a lack of interest in Sims.
But the real shift is about where EA wants its next big hit.
EA is now prioritising Project Evergreen, the rumored sequel to The Sims 4. The Sims 4, released in 2014, still draws millions of players.
So expect the next Sims adventure soon, just not Lotus, on consoles too.
